title: LOCO control for norway: 2803 random images held out
hypothesis: Part of any leave-one-country-out drop is explained purely by the smaller training set, with no domain shift involved.
falsifier: The control scores the same as the full-data E0 baseline, which would mean removing this many images costs nothing and the whole LOCO drop is attributable to domain.
gate: This run exists only to be subtracted from its LOCO partner. It is not a result on its own and should not appear in a leaderboard as one.
notes: Matched to E10-loco-norway at 2803 held-out images. Same seed, same class set, same schedule - the ONLY difference from its partner is which images were removed.

class_set_detail.name: all10
class_set_detail.description: All ten N-RDD2024 classes. The control.
class_set_detail.rationale: The baseline every other class set is measured against. Identical to the current production configuration, so E0's numbers apply directly.
